title: What Lithium-Sulfur Batteries Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Lithium-sulfur batteries pair lithium anodes with sulfur cathodes — sulfur being nearly free and ultra-abundant — reaching 400-600 Wh/kg in theory. They are the lightweight, cheap battery for aviation and long-range EVs, once the polysulfide shuttle is tamed. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Lithium-Sulfur Batteries: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Lithium-Sulfur Batteries in one line: Lithium-sulfur batteries pair lithium anodes with sulfur cathodes — sulfur being nearly free and ultra-abundant — reaching 400-600 Wh/kg in theory.
Why it matters: Sulfur costs almost nothing and stores enormous energy: the battery for weight-critical uses..
Where it is used: electric aviation, drones, long-range EVs, grid (low-cost)..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
